B.Thukkaram vs The Secretary To Government on 4 January, 
2024 
Author: G.K.Ilanthiraiyan
Bench: G.K.Ilanthiraiyan
 W.P.No.35489 
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras
 Dated :04.01.2024
 Coram
 The Honourable Mr.Justice G.K.Ilanthiraiyan
 W.P.No.35489 of 2023
 B.Thukkaram ..... Petitioner
 Vs
 1. The Secretary to Government,
 Home Department,
 Secretariat, Chennai.
 2. Director General of Police,
 Mylapore, Chennai.
 3. Deputy Inspector General of Police,
 Kanchipuram Range, Kanchipuram.
 4. District Superintendent of Police,
 Collectorate Campus, Kanchipuram. 
 5. District Superintendent of Police,
 Q-Branch C.I.D
 Mylapore , Chennai. ..... Respondents
 Prayer:-  Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of Constitution of I  for the issuance of Writ of Mandamus, directing the respondents to  consider the representation of petitioner dated 03.11.2023 and  consequently directing the respondents to pay additional charge  allowance for working as additional charge food safety officer to  Sriperumbudur Block from 10.01.2022 to till date. 
 Page 1 of 4 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis  W.P.No.3  For Petitioner : Mr.U.Jugal Kumar  For Respondents : Dr.T.Seenivasan  Special Government Pleader B.Thukkaram vs The Secretary To Government on 4 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41855294/
1  ORDER This Writ Petition has been filed for direction directing the first respondent to consider the representation of the petitioner dated 27.11.2023 and pay anomaly to him. 
2. The learned Government Advocate appearing for the respondents submitted that even the earlier representation submitted by the petitioner was already considered and the same was rejected by an order dated 01.11.2023 and again the petitioner had submitted another representation dated 27.11.2023. 
3. In view of the above submission, this writ petition is devoid of merits and it is liable to be dismissed. Accordingly, this Writ Petition stands dismissed. However, the petitioner is at liberty to challenge the rejection order in the manner known to law. No costs.
